underline the importance: The doctor's talk was meant to underline the importance of regular exercise for teenagers who sit for hours every day.

undermine the foundation: Heavy rain over many weeks may undermine the foundation of old houses built close to the river.

undertake to do: The builder agreed to undertake to do all the repairs for free if any problems appear within a year.

events unfolded: We stayed up all night watching the news as events unfolded after the earthquake hit the city.

watch history unfold: Millions of people stayed up late to watch history unfold as the first woman president gave her speech.
數百萬人熬夜觀看首位女總統發表演說，看歷史在眼前上演。
unite the country: After the terrible war, the new leader worked hard to unite the country and heal old wounds.
在那場可怕的戰爭之後，新領導人努力團結國家，撫平舊傷。
unite against a common enemy: The two rival tribes had to unite against a common enemy when invaders attacked their land.

unite in marriage: The couple will unite in marriage next spring in a small church near their hometown.
